topic: Luffy burning the flag gets the credit, but Robin's chapter 398 'I want to live' is what actually declared war on the World Government
title: Robin's I Want To Live Was The Real War Declaration
description: Everyone remembers the flag burning at Enies Lobby. I think the real declaration of war came a moment earlier, from Robin. Chapters 397 and 398 make the case. Do you agree?
comment: The real declaration of war: Luffy burning the flag, or Robin saying she wants to live? Pick one.

lines.text: Luffy didn't declare war on the World Government. Robin did.

shot.fallback: woman crying on a tower surrounded by fire

lines.text: Chapter 398. Luffy tells Sogeking to burn the World Government's flag.

shot.search: Sogeking shoots World Government flag Enies Lobby

lines.text: That's the famous image, and I get why.

shot.search: Straw Hats declare war World Government flag
shot.fallback: pirates in front of a burning flag

lines.text: But look at what comes right before it.
Chapter 397. Ohara burns, Saul smashes the Buster Call ship, and the scholars die saving history.

shot.search: Ohara Buster Call Saul Olvia Clover

lines.text: Robin was eight years old, with a bounty on her head.

shot.fallback: small girl alone on a ship

lines.text: For twenty years she ran from a world that wanted her dead.

shot.search: Nico Robin young Devil Child running

lines.text: Then Luffy tells her to say it. And she says she wants to live.

shot.search: Nico Robin I want to live Luffy
shot.fallback: woman tearfully shouting on a tower

lines.text: Remember what the World Government erased: the Void Century, and the people who dared to read it.
A woman who can read Poneglyphs choosing life is the one thing that plan can't survive.
People say the flag burn is the literal declaration, and that's true.
But a flag burn is a gesture. Robin choosing to live was the first shot.
